name: Salons & Barbershops
title: Field Sales Team for Salons and Barbershops | Our Wellness Network
description: Our field team visits the bridal shops, boutiques and studios near your salon or barbershop in Oak Brook, Lombard or Hinsdale and builds a referral network you can track.
cardBlurb: We visit the bridal shops, boutiques and studios near you and build a referral network you can track.
intro: We visit the businesses around your salon or barbershop, build relationships with their staff and turn them into a referral network you can track. Every stop and every sign-up shows up in your portal.
partnersIntro: People getting ready for a wedding, a photo shoot, an interview or a night out stop at these businesses too, and they want their hair to match the occasion.

partners.name: Bridal shops
partners.why: Brides and their wedding parties need hair for the big day, and they start planning it once the dress is chosen.

partners.name: Clothing and menswear stores
partners.why: Shoppers buying an outfit for an interview or an event often want a fresh cut or color to go with it.

partners.name: Photography studios
partners.why: Headshots, family portraits and engagement photos are booked by people who want to look their best on camera.

partners.name: Gyms and fitness studios
partners.why: Members who keep a routine for how they look and feel often keep a standing haircut too.

partners.name: Tailors and dry cleaners
partners.why: Their regulars are getting suits and dresses ready for interviews, weddings and big nights out.

partners.name: Event venues and planners
partners.why: Every wedding, gala and party they host has guests who want their hair done that day.

treatsIntro: On every visit, our field team brings coffee and treats for the whole staff at each partner business. It's simple hospitality, it's included in your plan, and it's the reason staff are glad to see us walk in.
treatExamples: Coffee and scones for a bridal shop's Saturday team
Muffins and coffee for a gym's early front desk crew
Cookies and coffee for a dry cleaner's afternoon counter staff
portalNote: In your portal you see every stop we make for your salon or barbershop and every sign-up that comes through a partner's code, ready for you to call and book. It's how you see which partnerships are working, business by business.

notes.title: A one-page partner agreement
notes.text: Every partner business signs a one-page agreement: mutual promotion, and nobody is paid per referral or per customer.

notes.title: No competing chairs
notes.text: Our matching software leaves other salons and barbershops off your route, and we skip any business you already work with unless you ask.

notes.title: Your words only
notes.text: We introduce your salon or barbershop only in words you've approved, and we leave only the printed materials you've signed off on.

exclusivity: Partners agree to promote one salon or barbershop like yours, and only yours, for as long as you are a client.

faq.q: Will you visit other salons or barbershops near me?
faq.a: No. Our matching software ranks the businesses near you that share your customers and don't compete with you. You approve the list before we visit anyone.
Every sign-up shows up in your portal with the business and staff member whose code it came through. You or your front desk call and book them the way you book everyone else.

faq.q: What do you leave at each business?
faq.a: With each business's permission, your printed materials where staff and customers will see them, and a personal tap-to-schedule card for every staff member we meet. We come back every month to restock and meet new staff.
